Fang Jiangang's public work centres on building commercial links between Zhejiang and Singapore. As president of the Singapore Zhejiang Entrepreneurs Association, he leads a network that brings companies, investors and advisers together for market entry, investment and business exchange. He previously served as the association's secretary-general, giving him a sustained role in its development.

That platform has convened delegations and conferences covering technology, international expansion and sustainable development. Fang is also identified by the association as a co-founder of the Zhejiang Overseas Fund. Through meetings with chambers, public organisations and business groups, he has promoted Singapore as a base for Zhejiang companies entering global markets. He has also encouraged overseas partners to engage with the province.
